artworks.title: Wooded Landscape beside a River
artworks.medium: graphite and white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with trees on either side. Beyond the trees, there is a horizon with faint silhouetted trees further back. The pencil strokes show detailed textures and lines defining the foliage and landscape. The color palette consists of gray tones, creating a calm atmosphere. A person stands near the trees, and a body of water curves through the scene leading to the horizon. The sky in the background has soft clouds.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body at the center with long, curly hair, a crown of thorns, neutral expression, a beard, and draped in a cloth. Three other figures surround him, one wearing a detailed helmet with a plume to the left, a bearded man with a turban-like head covering to the right, and another figure gesturing towards the center. In the lower right, a woman is depicted holding a cloth to her face. The scene is set against a simple architectural backdrop with vertical elements like columns or a doorway. The artwork is monochrome with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Two Sibyls and an Angel
artworks.artist: Giovanni Antonio da Brescia, after Raphael
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts two women seated on clouds with two flying cherubs. One woman has a headdress and extends her arm, while the other woman holds a book and gestures to a cherub carrying a scroll. The cherubs have wings; one is flying above with a scroll, and the other is near the women. The scene includes detailed drapery of the women's robes and stylized clouds.

artworks.title: Trees at Fordland, Devon
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash on heavy laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with trees dominating the composition. The view is upward towards the canopy, focusing on the arrangement of tree trunks and branches. The brushstrokes are detailed, emphasizing textures through fine lines and gray tones. The color palette is monochromatic, creating a tranquil impact. Thick, gnarled trunks are prominent on the right side, with sinuous trees extending beyond. In the distance, trees thin out slightly, allowing light to filter through.

artworks.title: Stags in Knole Park, Kent
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of  Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with deer resting on grass, framed by trees on both sides. The horizon is near the upper third, meeting a sky with soft clouds. The painting style is detailed and naturalistic, capturing textures of fur and grass. The color palette includes soft greens, browns, tans, grays, and blues. Additional deer can be seen in the distance.

artworks.title: Bristol Cathedral from College Green
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a gothic-style architectural structure, possibly a cathedral. The building is positioned slightly off-center to the right and dominates the scene with intricate detailing and pointed arches. The horizon is low, where the building meets the ground. The drawing uses precise pencil strokes to outline the architecture and surrounding trees. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow effects. Additional structures are subtly depicted in the background, appearing smaller as they recede. Trees border the left side of the scene.

artworks.title: The Ramparts, Mont St. Michel, France
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with scratching out, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scenery with calm water reflecting structures in the background. A small boat with figures is seen on the left, and on the right, there are stone fortifications, possibly part of a castle. A rocky cliff blends into the architecture, and the sky merges into a light blue on the horizon. The color palette is soft, with pastel tones creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Wrekin, Shropshire
artworks.medium: gray wash over traces of graphite with pen and brown and gray ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The image features a landscape seen from a slightly elevated angle. A mountain stands prominently in the center, with a thin line of trees and small figures visible on the horizon. Smoke or mist rises from the peak of the mountain, blending into the sky. Lush, dense vegetation surrounds the base of the mountain, with soft brushstrokes and a monochromatic grayscale palette used to depict the scene.

artworks.title: View of Oxford from Headington Hill
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Krugman Family Foundation

artworks.title: Saints Peter and John Healing the Lame Man at the Golden Gate
artworks.artist: Parmigianino and Antonio da Trento or Ugo da Carpi, after Raphael
artworks.medium: etching and chiaroscuro woodcut, printed in brown and black from two blocks and one plate on laid paper, laid down on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of  Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a classical architectural setting. The scene includes figures in draped garments, surrounding columns with Corinthian capitals. The setting suggests a hall or temple-like environment. The central figures appear to be engaged in dialogue or teaching, while others observe. The figures have various postures, creating movement across the composition. The drawing uses a sepia tone and cross-hatching for depth and texture, reminiscent of Renaissance art.

artworks.title: The Death of Meleager
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 30.2 × 41.5 cm (11 7/8 × 16 5/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological battle scene. The image features several figures engaging in a struggle or battle, with expressions of intensity and movement. The central focus is on multiple figures, some appearing to clash, one figure lying on the ground, seemingly wounded, and another standing, gesturing emphatically. In the background, additional figures, including mythological characters, are depicted atop clouds with bows. The image portrays drama and tension, with detailed musculature highlighting the physicality of the scene. The landscape in the background features varied terrains, including rocky outcrops and trees.

artworks.title: The Presentation in the Temple
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white gouache on blue-green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with several figures gathered around a central focal point. The drawing depicts a group of figures surrounding a child at the center of the composition. The scene is set within an architectural framework containing columns and draped curtains. The use of white highlights on the figures and clothing creates depth and draws attention to specific details in the attire and expressions of those portrayed. The overall composition is harmonious and balanced, with an emphasis on the central figures.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: William B. O'Neal Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up drawing of a person's upper body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The individual is in a three-quarter view, slightly turning towards the viewer. The face is detailed with a straight nose, shaded eyes, and closed lips. Blush is added to the cheeks for realism. The person has light, softly curled hair. They wear draped fabric resembling a cloak or wrap. The plain background directs attention to the subject.

artworks.title: Edmund and Charlotte Ashworth and Family at Egerton Hall
artworks.medium: daguerreotype
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a group portrait of eleven individuals. There are eight individuals standing at the back and three people seated in the front. At the center is a woman with a child on her lap and two more children around her. The adults are positioned around them in the back. The man standing behind the woman is dressed formally in a dark jacket, white shirt, and a bow tie. The woman wears a bonnet, and each child wears long-sleeved dresses. One of the standing men holds a small book. The boys and men wear dark suits with white collars. The background shows a stone wall and a window. The image is framed with a decorative blue border.

artworks.title: Pêche de la Baleine, Whale-Fishery
artworks.artist: Friedrich von Martens, after Louis Garneray, published by Goupil & Vibert
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harry W. Havemeyer in memory of his father, Horace Havemeyer

artworks.title: Pêche du Cachalot, Cachalot Fishery
artworks.artist: Friedrich von Martens, after Louis Garneray
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, and engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Harry W. Havemeyer in memory of his father, Horace Havemeyer

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment Fund
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an older man's upper body, shown from the chest up. He is seated and leaning slightly forward with his left hand resting against his cheek. The man has a full beard and mustache, thinning white or light gray hair, and a neutral expression. He is wearing a dark jacket over a light-colored shirt. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a square of shading. The artwork is signed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Two Studies of the Head of a Young Man Crowned with a Laurel Wreath
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two side profile busts of a person with long wavy hair. Both profiles are depicted from the shoulder up. The left profile is slightly turned towards the viewer, while the right one is facing away. Both profiles have detailed facial structures with strong noses and chins. They wear a laurel wreath tied at the back, intricately sketched into their hair. The clothing is minimally indicated as a robe or draped garment. In the background, the paper is plain, emphasizing the detailed figures. The drawing includes ink notes and a signature at the bottom, with a date marked as 1813.

artworks.title: Saddled Horse with a Study of a Rider
artworks.medium: graphite on tracing paper mounted on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse with a saddle. The drawing depicts a horse standing in profile view. The horse is equipped with a saddle. In the background, there are faint unfinished sketches of another figure atop another horse. The composition focuses on the details of the horse's anatomy and the lines that define its posture and stance.

artworks.title: A False Scalping Performed by Iowa Tribe Members in Paris
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee
artworks.description: The image is an ink drawing featuring two figures. One figure is standing and leaning over the other figure, who is lying on the ground. The standing figure appears to be male, with angular limbs, hair, and a garment with tassels. The figure on the ground has one arm outstretched and one bent, with indistinct facial features. Bold lines emphasize the musculature of both figures. The background is plain and textured.

artworks.title: Arab Horseman at the Gallop
artworks.medium: graphite on tracing paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure riding a horse. The drawing is a sketch done in pencil on paper. The central focus is on a figure on a rearing horse. The figure is gripping a banner in one hand and wielding an object in the other. The horse is captured mid-stride, with detailed anatomy and a defined expression. The background is subtly hinted at with light pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Study of a Male Nude and Other Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and graphite, heightened with white gouache, on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a nude male figure seen from the back. The figure is standing with one arm bent against a wall, leaning slightly forward. The hair is dark and short, depicted with loose strokes. The figure is not wearing any clothes, highlighting his musculature and form through light and shadow. The background is a textured, light-colored surface with faint sketches of other figures and shapes in the upper right corner. In the lower right area, there is a red circular stamp with the word "Fortuny".

artworks.title: A Roman Cloister
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash and watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee
artworks.description: The image shows a covered outdoor hallway or patio viewed slightly from the side. The architecture leads the viewer's eyes from left to right towards a doorway and window in shadow. On the left, there are textured stone walls and an arched entrance opening into a darkened interior space. A figure in a cloak stands in the shadow, while another figure leans on the ledge of an opening. The roofline is angled and supported by a beam, directing the gaze towards the open, bright area on the right where potted plants are placed against the wall. Loose and expressive brushstrokes capture the rough stone texture and shadows. The color palette consists of warm earth tones, muted browns, slate gray, and pale blues, creating an enclosed yet light-exposed atmosphere.

artworks.title: Study for "Rêve d'amour"
artworks.medium: red, black, and white chalk, with stumping, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of William B. Jordan and Robert Dean Brownlee
artworks.description: The image features a drawing of a naked male figure who is reclining, leaning on one arm, and holding an unfinished shape in the other hand. The person's head is turned slightly to the left with a focused gaze. The individual's facial features are well-defined, with a strong jawline and long hair falling over the shoulders. There are sketches of garments and outlines of another figure surrounding the main figure. The background is a plain, textured surface with scattered sketches and scribbles. There is some writing in the bottom left corner, suggesting that this is a study or preliminary work of art.
